pp_intro.text: Press the clay with your fingers! How many Peeps can ride the train?

pp_go.text: How many Peeps can ride this time?

pp_some.text: Some Peeps are on the train already. Fill the empty seats!

pp_quick2.text: How many did you see? Press that many!

pp_extra.text: Oh! That Peep has no seat. Tap it to send it home!

cm_spots5_horns2.text: Can I have a friend with five spots and two horns, please?

cm_double4.text: Please make me a friend with double four spots!

cm_double6.text: Please make me a friend with double six spots!

cm_yes.text: It matches my card! Thank you!

cm_not.text: Hmm. That's not quite like my card.

pk_intro.text: Peek-a-Peep! Some Peeps will peep out. Look quickly!

dress_hi.text: Dress-up time! Tap the clothes to try them on.

dress_coins.text: Play a game to earn more coins!

bay_poke.text: Poke Pals is next! Tap it to play!

bay_critter.text: Critter Maker is next! Tap it to play!

bay_slices.text: Fair Slices is next! Tap it to play!

bay_hatch.text: Your egg is waiting! Tap the Hatch!

bay_done.text: You played them all today! Come back tomorrow!

bay_coins.text: Play games to earn coins. Then tap the shirt to dress up!

bay_garden.text: Tap the flower to visit your critters in the garden!

bay_shape.text: Pull-a-Shape is next! Tap it to play!

bay_seesaw.text: Seesaw Twins is next! Tap it to play!

bay_parade.text: Parade Squares is next! Tap it to play!

bay_dig.text: Treasure Packing is next! Tap it to play!

bay_review.text: Let's play one you know! Tap it!

bay_new.text: Something new to learn! Tap it to play!

bay_practise.text: Practice time! Tap it to play!

bay_soon.text: That game is coming soon! Let's play another one!

bay_maths.text: Tap the books to see all your maths!

kc_intro.text: Race you! Every right answer is a boost!

kc_dots.text: No hurry! Look at the dots, then type.

kc_time.text: Time's up! Let's look at the board.

kc_win.text: You won! That was a great race!

kc_lose.text: That was close! Shall we race again?

kc_calm.text: We made it! What a race!

pp_l_press.text: Press the clay. A Peep pops out of each fingertip dent! Fill the shining seats.

pp_l_numeral.text: Look at the number tile. Press that many Peeps out of the clay!

pp_l_ask.text: How many Peeps? Choose your answer.

pp_l_scatter.text: The Peeps are all mixed up! Tap each Peep to help it onto the coaster. Then tell me how many.

pp_l_zero.text: Zero Peeps! Nobody is on the coaster.

pp_l_more.text: One more Peep wants a ride. Press the clay once!

pp_l_fewer.text: One Peep is going home. Tap one Peep to help it off!

pp_l_same.text: Make the second car the same as the first. Press the clay for its Peeps!

pp_l_compare_more.text: Which group has more Peeps? Tap that group, or its arrow.

pp_l_compare_fewer.text: Which group has fewer Peeps? Tap that group, or its arrow.

pp_l_compare_same.text: If both have the same number, you can choose the same tile.

pp_l_together.text: Some Peeps are riding. Press more Peeps into the shining seats. How many altogether?

pp_l_off.text: The Peeps with shining rings are getting off. Tap to help them off. How many are left?

pp_l_story_on.text: Some Peeps are riding at the beach. More friends come for a ride! Fill the shining seats. How many are riding now?

pp_l_story_off.text: Some Peeps are riding at the beach. The friends with shining rings go home. Help them off. How many are left?

pp_l_parts.text: Make the number on the card. Some Peeps are riding already. How many more do you need?

pp_l_make10.text: Some Peeps are on the coaster. How many more fill all ten seats? Press them out, then put the missing number in the box.

pp_l_teenAsk.text: One full coaster is ten. There are some more on the next ride. How many altogether?

pp_l_teenBuild.text: Look at the number tile. Ten Peeps are riding already. Press some more for the next ride to make that number!

pp_l_countOn.text: Start with the number on the car. Press more Peeps into the shining seats. Count on with me! Then put the total in the box.

pp_l_countBack.text: Start with the Peeps riding. Tap the shining Peeps off. Count back with me! Then put how many are left in the box.

pp_l_through.text: Tap the waiting Peeps. Fill the first coaster to ten. The rest wait for the next ride. How many Peeps altogether?

pp_l_backTo10.text: Take Peeps off the extra ride first. That brings us back to ten. Then take the rest off. How many are left?

pp_l_tip_count.text: Let's count the Peeps one at a time. The dots can help us keep track.

pp_l_tip_seats.text: Look at the shining seats and rings. Count each Peep once. A Peep with no seat can go home with a tap.

pp_l_tip_compare.text: Match one Peep in this group with one in that group. Look for any left over.

pp_l_tip_ten.text: Look at the two fives. A full coaster is ten. What comes before or after ten?

pp_l_show.text: Let's work it out together, one Peep at a time.

pp_l_twin.text: Now try another little ride like that one!

pp_l_ten.text: Ten! The first coaster is full. The other Peeps wait for the next ride.

pp_l_next.text: Ten on the coaster, and some more waiting for the next ride. Put them together!

pp_l_back_ten.text: The extra ride comes off first. Back to ten! Now take the rest away.

pp_l_ride.text: All aboard! Round the loop we go!

pp_l_end.text: What lovely counting! Hooray for our coaster friends!

pp_l_check.text: When you're ready, tap the tick to check your Peeps.

pp_l_same_yes.text: Look! A Peep here matches a Peep there. Both cars have the same number!

pp_l_plus1.text: One and one more is two!

pp_l_plus2.text: Two and one more is three!

pp_l_plus3.text: Three and one more is four!

pp_l_plus4.text: Four and one more is five!

pp_l_plus5.text: Five and one more is six!

pp_l_plus6.text: Six and one more is seven!

pp_l_plus7.text: Seven and one more is eight!

pp_l_plus8.text: Eight and one more is nine!

pp_l_plus9.text: Nine and one more is ten!

pp_l_minus2.text: Two and one fewer is one!

pp_l_minus3.text: Three and one fewer is two!

pp_l_minus4.text: Four and one fewer is three!

pp_l_minus5.text: Five and one fewer is four!

pp_l_minus6.text: Six and one fewer is five!

pp_l_minus7.text: Seven and one fewer is six!

pp_l_minus8.text: Eight and one fewer is seven!

pp_l_minus9.text: Nine and one fewer is eight!

pk_type_number.text: Tap the number keys, then OK!

pk_bigger.text: Which group has more Peeps? Tap that side!

pk_tip_groups.text: Look for little groups you know. Have another look!

pk_tip_frame.text: A full row is five. Look at the rows!

pk_tip_pair.text: Look at each little group. Then think about them together!

pk_tip_more.text: Look at one group, then the other. Which has more?

pk_count_together.text: Let's count them together. Watch where I look!

pk_five.text: A full row is five. Five and some more!

pk_ten.text: One full frame is ten. Ten and some more!

pk_add.text: These two groups join to make the total!

pk_fill_ten.text: Let's hop some Peeps across to fill the first ten!

pk_ten_full.text: Now we have ten, and the Peeps left over. The total stays the same!

pk_fresh.text: Let's try a fresh one like that!

pk_more_left.text: The group on the left has more Peeps!

pk_more_right.text: The group on the right has more Peeps!

kc_jump.text: Three in a row! A big jump!

pc_intro.text: Pool party! Tap the sky, and a Peep jumps from my balloon!

pc_toomany.text: One too many. Up you go!

pc_tip_few.text: Not enough yet. Tap the sky for more.

pc_tip_many.text: Too many! Tap a Peep to send it back up.

pc_check.text: Tap the tick when that's enough.

pc_one_more.text: One more is coming! Tap the sky.

pc_one_fewer.text: One is going home! Tap a Peep.

pc_tip_count.text: Point at each one and count.

pc_next.text: Which number comes next? Tap its parachute.

pc_tip_line.text: The first one is at the front, by the pool. Count from there.

pc_stairs.text: Each step is one more! Make the next step.

pc_tip_stairs.text: Look at the step before. One more than that.

pc_end.text: What a party! Thanks for helping!

pc_want_1.text: One Peep for my pool party! Tap the sky.

pc_want_2.text: Two Peeps for my pool party! Tap the sky.

pc_want_3.text: Three Peeps for my pool party! Tap the sky.

pc_want_4.text: Four Peeps for my pool party! Tap the sky.

pc_want_5.text: Five Peeps for my pool party! Tap the sky.

pc_want_6.text: Six Peeps for my pool party! Tap the sky.

pc_want_7.text: Seven Peeps for my pool party! Tap the sky.

pc_want_8.text: Eight Peeps for my pool party! Tap the sky.

pc_want_9.text: Nine Peeps for my pool party! Tap the sky.

pc_want_10.text: Ten Peeps for my pool party! Tap the sky.

pc_want_11.text: Eleven Peeps for my pool party! Tap the sky.

pc_want_12.text: Twelve Peeps for my pool party! Tap the sky.

pc_want_13.text: Thirteen Peeps for my pool party! Tap the sky.

pc_want_14.text: Fourteen Peeps for my pool party! Tap the sky.

pc_want_15.text: Fifteen Peeps for my pool party! Tap the sky.

pc_want_16.text: Sixteen Peeps for my pool party! Tap the sky.

pc_want_17.text: Seventeen Peeps for my pool party! Tap the sky.

pc_want_18.text: Eighteen Peeps for my pool party! Tap the sky.

pc_want_19.text: Nineteen Peeps for my pool party! Tap the sky.

pc_want_20.text: Twenty Peeps for my pool party! Tap the sky.

pc_land_in_pool.text: Land this Peep in the pool!

pc_find_in_pool.text: Which Peep is in the pool?

pc_land_on_rock.text: Land this Peep on the rock!

pc_find_on_rock.text: Which Peep is on the rock?

pc_land_under_umbrella.text: Land this Peep under the umbrella!

pc_find_under_umbrella.text: Which Peep is under the umbrella?

pc_land_above_pool.text: Float this Peep above the pool!

pc_find_above_pool.text: Which Peep is above the pool?

pc_land_above_umbrella.text: Float this Peep above the umbrella!

pc_find_above_umbrella.text: Which Peep is above the umbrella?

pc_land_below_umbrella.text: Land this Peep below the umbrella!

pc_find_below_umbrella.text: Which Peep is below the umbrella?

pc_land_beside_pool.text: Land this Peep beside the pool!

pc_find_beside_pool.text: Which Peep is beside the pool?

pc_land_behind_rock.text: Land this Peep behind the rock!

pc_find_behind_rock.text: Which Peep is behind the rock?

pc_land_front_rock.text: Land this Peep in front of the rock!

pc_find_front_rock.text: Which Peep is in front of the rock?

pc_that_front_rock.text: That's in front of the rock.

pc_land_next_rock.text: Land this Peep next to the rock!

pc_find_next_rock.text: Which Peep is next to the rock?

pp_m_sort.text: This Peep wants its own colour. Tap the car!

pp_m_tip_sort.text: Look at the Peep. Which car is that colour?

pp_m_copy.text: Make this car the same as that one!

pp_m_continue.text: What comes next? Keep the pattern going!

pp_m_tip_pattern.text: Look at the first car. Say the colours.

pp_m_tip_next.text: Say the numbers, and keep going.

pp_m_ord_1.text: Tap the first Peep in the line.

pp_m_ord_2.text: Tap the second Peep in the line.

pp_m_ord_3.text: Tap the third Peep in the line.

pp_m_ord_4.text: Tap the fourth Peep in the line.

pp_m_ord_5.text: Tap the fifth Peep in the line.

pp_m_tip_ord.text: The first one is next to the arrow. Count from there.

pp_m_tens.text: Every car holds ten. How many Peeps?

pp_m_turn2.text: We swapped the cars! How many now?

pp_m_turn_same.text: The same! Swap them round, and it's still the same.

pp_m_big.text: Press this many more onto the train.

pp_m_tip_big.text: Count the full cars in tens. Then count on.

pp_m_break.text: Some have to get off, and there aren't enough here. Tap a full car!

pp_m_take.text: Now tap them to get off.

pp_m_equal.text: The same in every car. Press them on!

pp_m_tip_equal.text: Count each car, then count on to the next car.

bl_intro.text: Let's race our balloons up to the big cloud! Every right answer is a puff of hot air.

bl_win.text: You reached the big cloud! What a race!

qc_same.text: Which card has the same number?

qc_onemore.text: One more comes. How many now?

qc_onefewer.text: One goes away. How many now?

qc_tip_touch.text: Count them slowly. Touch each one once.

qc_tip_quick.text: Look for little groups. Twos and threes!

qc_tip_onemore.text: Count them all, then count one more.

qc_tip_match.text: Match them up, one and one. Which side has some left over?

qc_tip_track.text: Count up from one. Which number do you say later?

qc_tip_next.text: Say the numbers. What do you say next?

qc_tip_none.text: None means nothing at all. Zero!

qc_tip_look.text: Look at the number. Now count the dots.
